notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 available time-advance services at the inclusive GALT boundary. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies timestamped interaction delivery through Time Advance Request Available and Next Message Request Available, boundary ordering, retraction metadata, and grant servicing without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior. The additional zero-lookahead probe is supplemental only: after TARA(9) grants, it checks sender-side acceptance of a timestamp-9 send, with no delivery-timing claim and no separate requirement mapping. The page-198 statement that all equal-time messages are not guaranteed before a grant is a non-guarantee, not a required outcome; that incomplete candidate remains unmapped under RL-386.
